What is StatStreaks?

A daily football higher-or-lower guessing game built around one simple question: is this player's stat higher or lower than the last? Whether it's Premier League goals, international caps, or club appearances — if you know your football, you'll love it.

Daily Mode

Every day brings a new themed challenge with 11 player cards. Guess correctly to build your Career Caps streak. Two wrong answers and you're out — come back tomorrow to keep it going.

Rush Mode

30 seconds. As many correct answers as you can. Multiple categories to compete across — Premier League goals, international caps, club appearances and more. Score big enough and you'll top the global leaderboard.

Who made it?

StatStreaks was built by a football fan, for football fans. It's completely free to play. If you enjoy it, tell a mate — that's all the support we need.

Ready To Play?

Today's challenge is waiting. How many can you get right?
